levels.name: Gaze of the Deep
levels.description: Even when Oz is not present in combat, he can still watch over Fischl through his raven eyes. When Fischl performs a Normal Attack against an opponent, Oz fires a coordinated attack, dealing DMG equal to 22% of Fischl's ATK.

levels.name: Devourer of All Sins
levels.description: When Nightrider is used, it deals an additional 200% ATK as DMG, and its AoE is increased by 50%.

levels.name: Wings of Nightmare
levels.description: Increases the Level of Nightrider by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Her Pilgrimage of Bleak
levels.description: When Midnight Phantasmagoria is used, it deals 222% of ATK as Electro DMG to surrounding opponents. When the skill duration ends, Fischl regenerates 20% of her HP.

levels.name: Against the Fleeing Light
levels.description: Increases the Level of Midnight Phantasmagoria by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Evernight Raven
levels.description: Extends the duration of Oz's presence on the field by 2s. Additionally, Oz performs coordinated attacks with your active character when present, dealing 30% of Fischl's ATK as Electro DMG.
